title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slipped to sixty-three thousand five hundred thirty-three dollars at the US close, down nine-tenths of a percent as fear gripped the tape at a twenty-eight reading. Daily range held tight with no breakout conviction.

Hashrate remains elevated at nine hundred fifteen EH/s, signaling miner resolve despite the dip. Mempool sits heavy at ninety-five thousand transactions yet fees stay low at two sat/vB, pointing to steady but unhurried demand.

Key takeaway: price is absorbing selling witho
